num_nonnulls("clinical_media"."removed_at", "clinical_media"."removed_by", "clinical_media"."removed_as", "clinical_media"."removed_reason") in (0, 4)
      and ("clinical_media"."removed_reason" is null or length(btrim("clinical_media"."removed_reason")) between 3 and 500)

clinical_media_blobs_check.name: clinical_media_blobs_check
clinical_media_blobs_check.value:
"clinical_media_blobs"."content_type" in ('image/jpeg','image/png','application/pdf') and "clinical_media_blobs"."sha256" = encode(sha256("clinical_media_blobs"."content"), 'hex')
      and "clinical_media_blobs"."size_bytes" = octet_length("clinical_media_blobs"."content") and "clinical_media_blobs"."size_bytes" between 1 and 5242880

clinical_requests_one_pending_item.name: clinical_requests_one_pending_item
clinical_requests_one_pending_item.where: state = 'pending' and target_item_id is not null

clinical_requests_kind_check.name: clinical_requests_kind_check
clinical_requests_kind_check.value:
"clinical_requests"."kind" in ('addition','plan_change','substitution') and (("clinical_requests"."kind" = 'addition') = ("clinical_requests"."target_item_id" is null))
      and "clinical_requests"."stage" between 1 and 20 and "clinical_requests"."qty" between 1 and 1000
      and (("clinical_requests"."dose_micro" is null) = ("clinical_requests"."dose_unit" is null)) and ("clinical_requests"."dose_micro" is null or "clinical_requests"."dose_micro" between 1 and 1000000000)
      and ("clinical_requests"."dose_unit" is null or "clinical_requests"."dose_unit" in ('unit','ml','mg','cm2')) and length(btrim("clinical_requests"."reason")) between 3 and 500
      and "clinical_requests"."requested_as" in ('bc','doctor','nurse','therapist')

clinical_requests_state_check.name: clinical_requests_state_check
clinical_requests_state_check.value:
"clinical_requests"."state" in ('pending','approved','declined','cancelled')
      and (("clinical_requests"."state" = 'pending') = ("clinical_requests"."decided_at" is null)) and num_nonnulls("clinical_requests"."decided_by", "clinical_requests"."decided_as") in (0, 2)
      and (("clinical_requests"."state" in ('approved','declined')) = ("clinical_requests"."decided_by" is not null))
      and ("clinical_requests"."decided_as" is null or "clinical_requests"."decided_as" in ('doctor','facility_head')) and ("clinical_requests"."decided_by" is null or "clinical_requests"."decided_by" <> "clinical_requests"."requested_by")
      and (("clinical_requests"."state" = 'approved') = ("clinical_requests"."added_item_id" is not null))
      and (("clinical_requests"."state" = 'declined') = ("clinical_requests"."decision_reason" is not null)) and ("clinical_requests"."decision_reason" is null or length(btrim("clinical_requests"."decision_reason")) between 3 and 500)

complaint_events_check.name: complaint_events_check
complaint_events_check.value:
"complaint_events"."kind" in ('flagged','taken','triaged','note','resolved','reopened','escalated') and "complaint_events"."task_kind" in ('klinis','layanan')
      and (("complaint_events"."kind" in ('note','resolved','reopened')) = ("complaint_events"."note" is not null)) and ("complaint_events"."note" is null or length(btrim("complaint_events"."note")) between 3 and 1000)
      and (("complaint_events"."kind" = 'escalated') = ("complaint_events"."actor_id" is null)) and num_nonnulls("complaint_events"."actor_id", "complaint_events"."actor_role") in (0, 2)

complaint_tasks_kind_check.name: complaint_tasks_kind_check
complaint_tasks_kind_check.value:
"complaint_tasks"."kind" in ('klinis','layanan')
      and (("complaint_tasks"."kind" = 'klinis') = ("complaint_tasks"."triage" is not null and "complaint_tasks"."category" is null))
      and (("complaint_tasks"."kind" = 'layanan') = ("complaint_tasks"."category" is not null and "complaint_tasks"."triage" is null))
      and ("complaint_tasks"."triage" is null or "complaint_tasks"."triage" in ('merah','kuning','hijau')) and ("complaint_tasks"."category" is null or "complaint_tasks"."category" in ('waktu_tunggu','tagihan','sikap_staf','lainnya'))

complaint_tasks_source_check.name: complaint_tasks_source_check
complaint_tasks_source_check.value:
"complaint_tasks"."source" in ('visit_note','staff_flag','pharmacist','message') and ("complaint_tasks"."source" <> 'visit_note' or "complaint_tasks"."visit_id" is not null)
      and ("complaint_tasks"."source" <> 'pharmacist' or ("complaint_tasks"."kind" = 'klinis' and "complaint_tasks"."flagged_as" = 'pharmacist'))
      and "complaint_tasks"."flagged_as" in ('fo_cashier','central_cs','bc','doctor','nurse','pharmacist','facility_head','manager') and ("complaint_tasks"."flagged_as" <> 'manager' or "complaint_tasks"."kind" = 'layanan')

complaint_tasks_state_check.name: complaint_tasks_state_check
complaint_tasks_state_check.value:
"complaint_tasks"."state" in ('open','in_progress','resolved')
      and (("complaint_tasks"."state" = 'open') = ("complaint_tasks"."assigned_to" is null and "complaint_tasks"."assigned_as" is null)) and num_nonnulls("complaint_tasks"."assigned_to", "complaint_tasks"."assigned_as") in (0, 2)
      and (("complaint_tasks"."state" = 'resolved') = (num_nonnulls("complaint_tasks"."resolved_at", "complaint_tasks"."resolved_by", "complaint_tasks"."resolved_as", "complaint_tasks"."resolution_outcome", "complaint_tasks"."resolution_note") = 5))
      and num_nonnulls("complaint_tasks"."resolved_at", "complaint_tasks"."resolved_by", "complaint_tasks"."resolved_as", "complaint_tasks"."resolution_outcome", "complaint_tasks"."resolution_note") in (0, 5)
      and ("complaint_tasks"."resolution_outcome" is null or "complaint_tasks"."resolution_outcome" in ('kontrol_gratis','edukasi','resep_tambahan','rujuk','penjelasan','jadwal_ulang','eskalasi_tagihan','pembinaan_staf','lainnya'))

complaint_tasks_text_check.name: complaint_tasks_text_check
complaint_tasks_text_check.value:
length(btrim("complaint_tasks"."summary")) between 3 and 1000
      and ("complaint_tasks"."resolution_note" is null or length(btrim("complaint_tasks"."resolution_note")) between 3 and 1000) and "complaint_tasks"."due_at" > "complaint_tasks"."created_at"

contraindication_reviews_check.name: contraindication_reviews_check
contraindication_reviews_check.value:
"contraindication_reviews"."decision" in ('cleared','blocked') and "contraindication_reviews"."version" >= 1
      and ("contraindication_reviews"."reason" is null or length(btrim("contraindication_reviews"."reason")) between 3 and 500) and ("contraindication_reviews"."decision" <> 'blocked' or "contraindication_reviews"."reason" is not null)

examinations_state_check.name: examinations_state_check
examinations_state_check.value:
"examinations"."state" in ('draft','signed')
      and num_nonnulls("examinations"."signed_at", "examinations"."signed_by", "examinations"."signed_as", "examinations"."content_hash") = (case when "examinations"."state" = 'signed' then 4 else 0 end)
      and ("examinations"."signed_by" is null or "examinations"."signed_by" = "examinations"."author_id") and ("examinations"."signed_as" is null or "examinations"."signed_as" = 'doctor')
      and ("examinations"."content_hash" is null or "examinations"."content_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

examinations_text_check.name: examinations_text_check
examinations_text_check.value:
("examinations"."subjective" is null or length("examinations"."subjective") <= 4000) and ("examinations"."objective" is null or length("examinations"."objective") <= 4000)
      and ("examinations"."assessment" is null or length("examinations"."assessment") <= 4000) and ("examinations"."plan_note" is null or length("examinations"."plan_note") <= 4000)
      and ("examinations"."template_key" is null or "examinations"."template_key" ~ '^[a-z][a-z_]{1,40}$') and jsonb_typeof("examinations"."template_values") = 'object' and jsonb_typeof("examinations"."vitals") = 'object'

face_map_marks_point_check.name: face_map_marks_point_check
face_map_marks_point_check.value:
"face_map_marks"."template" in ('face_front','face_left','face_right','body') and "face_map_marks"."layer" in ('keluhan','pemeriksaan','tindakan')
      and "face_map_marks"."x" between 0 and 1000 and "face_map_marks"."y" between 0 and 1000 and length(btrim("face_map_marks"."label")) between 1 and 120

face_map_marks_dose_check.name: face_map_marks_dose_check
face_map_marks_dose_check.value:
(("face_map_marks"."layer" = 'tindakan') = ("face_map_marks"."dose_micro" is not null and "face_map_marks"."dose_unit" is not null))
      and ("face_map_marks"."dose_micro" is null or "face_map_marks"."dose_micro" between 1 and 1000000000) and ("face_map_marks"."dose_unit" is null or "face_map_marks"."dose_unit" in ('unit','ml','mg','cm2'))
      and ("face_map_marks"."layer" = 'tindakan' or "face_map_marks"."catalog_version_id" is null)

intake_verifications_decision_check.name: intake_verifications_decision_check
intake_verifications_decision_check.value:
"intake_verifications"."decision" in ('confirmed','corrected') and "intake_verifications"."provenance" = 'clinician_verified' and "intake_verifications"."version" >= 1
      and (("intake_verifications"."decision" = 'corrected') = ("intake_verifications"."corrected_value" is not null)) and ("intake_verifications"."corrected_value" is null or length(btrim("intake_verifications"."corrected_value")) between 1 and 500)

intakes_state_check.name: intakes_state_check
intakes_state_check.value:
"intakes"."state" in ('draft','sent') and ("intakes"."state" = 'sent') = ("intakes"."sent_at" is not null)
      and ("intakes"."state" = 'draft' or "intakes"."complaint" is not null)

intakes_text_check.name: intakes_text_check
intakes_text_check.value: "intakes"."complaint" is null or length(btrim("intakes"."complaint")) between 3 and 1000

media_tokens_check.name: media_tokens_check
media_tokens_check.value:
"media_tokens"."purpose" in ('view','download') and "media_tokens"."token_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
      and "media_tokens"."expires_at" > "media_tokens"."issued_at" and "media_tokens"."expires_at" <= "media_tokens"."issued_at" + interval '10 minutes'
      and "media_tokens"."used_count" >= 0 and (("media_tokens"."used_count" = 0) = ("media_tokens"."last_used_at" is null))

plan_items_request_check.name: plan_items_request_check
plan_items_request_check.value: "plan_items"."removed_by_request_id" is null or "plan_items"."removed_at" is not null

plan_items_check.name: plan_items_check
plan_items_check.value:
"plan_items"."stage" between 1 and 20 and "plan_items"."qty" between 1 and 1000
      and (("plan_items"."dose_micro" is null) = ("plan_items"."dose_unit" is null)) and ("plan_items"."dose_micro" is null or "plan_items"."dose_micro" between 1 and 1000000000)
      and ("plan_items"."dose_unit" is null or "plan_items"."dose_unit" in ('unit','ml','mg','cm2')) and ("plan_items"."note" is null or length(btrim("plan_items"."note")) between 1 and 500)

procedure_consent_items_check.name: procedure_consent_items_check
procedure_consent_items_check.value:
"procedure_consent_items"."stage" between 1 and 20 and "procedure_consent_items"."qty" between 1 and 1000
      and (("procedure_consent_items"."dose_micro" is null) = ("procedure_consent_items"."dose_unit" is null)) and ("procedure_consent_items"."dose_micro" is null or "procedure_consent_items"."dose_micro" between 1 and 1000000000)
      and ("procedure_consent_items"."dose_unit" is null or "procedure_consent_items"."dose_unit" in ('unit','ml','mg','cm2'))

procedure_consents_state_check.name: procedure_consents_state_check
procedure_consents_state_check.value:
"procedure_consents"."state" in ('active','superseded','withdrawn') and "procedure_consents"."version" >= 1 and "procedure_consents"."captured_as" in ('doctor','nurse')
      and (num_nonnulls("procedure_consents"."superseded_at", "procedure_consents"."superseded_by_id") = 2) = ("procedure_consents"."state" = 'superseded') and num_nonnulls("procedure_consents"."superseded_at", "procedure_consents"."superseded_by_id") in (0, 2)
      and (num_nonnulls("procedure_consents"."withdrawn_at", "procedure_consents"."withdrawn_by", "procedure_consents"."withdrawn_as", "procedure_consents"."withdraw_reason") = 4) = ("procedure_consents"."state" = 'withdrawn')
      and num_nonnulls("procedure_consents"."withdrawn_at", "procedure_consents"."withdrawn_by", "procedure_consents"."withdrawn_as", "procedure_consents"."withdraw_reason") in (0, 4)
      and ("procedure_consents"."withdraw_reason" is null or length(btrim("procedure_consents"."withdraw_reason")) between 3 and 500) and ("procedure_consents"."withdrawn_as" is null or "procedure_consents"."withdrawn_as" in ('doctor','nurse'))

procedure_consents_signer_check.name: procedure_consents_signer_check
procedure_consents_signer_check.value:
"procedure_consents"."signer" in ('patient','guardian')
      and (("procedure_consents"."signer" = 'guardian') = ("procedure_consents"."guardian_name" is not null and "procedure_consents"."guardian_relation" is not null))
      and ("procedure_consents"."signer" = 'guardian' or ("procedure_consents"."guardian_name" is null and "procedure_consents"."guardian_relation" is null))
      and ("procedure_consents"."guardian_name" is null or length(btrim("procedure_consents"."guardian_name")) between 2 and 120)
      and ("procedure_consents"."guardian_relation" is null or "procedure_consents"."guardian_relation" in ('ayah','ibu','wali','lainnya'))

procedure_consents_signature_check.name: procedure_consents_signature_check
procedure_consents_signature_check.value:
"procedure_consents"."signature_size" between 68 and 204800 and "procedure_consents"."signature_size" = octet_length("procedure_consents"."signature_png")
      and "procedure_consents"."signature_sha256" = encode(sha256("procedure_consents"."signature_png"), 'hex')
      and substring("procedure_consents"."signature_png" from 1 for 8) = '\x89504e470d0a1a0a'::bytea and substring("procedure_consents"."signature_png" from 13 for 4) = '\x49484452'::bytea

record_corrections_check.name: record_corrections_check
record_corrections_check.value:
"record_corrections"."state" in ('pending','approved','rejected','cancelled') and "record_corrections"."requested_as" = 'doctor'
      and jsonb_typeof("record_corrections"."delta") = 'object' and "record_corrections"."delta" <> '{}'::jsonb and length(btrim("record_corrections"."reason")) between 3 and 500
      and (("record_corrections"."state" = 'pending') = ("record_corrections"."decided_at" is null)) and (("record_corrections"."state" = 'approved') = ("record_corrections"."version_id" is not null))

record_versions_kind_check.name: record_versions_kind_check
record_versions_kind_check.value:
"record_versions"."kind" in ('original','correction') and "record_versions"."created_as" = 'doctor'
      and jsonb_typeof("record_versions"."content") = 'object' and "record_versions"."content_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
      and (("record_versions"."kind" = 'original') = ("record_versions"."version" = 1 and "record_versions"."delta" is null and "record_versions"."reason" is null and "record_versions"."approval_id" is null))
      and (("record_versions"."kind" = 'correction') = ("record_versions"."version" > 1 and "record_versions"."delta" is not null and jsonb_typeof("record_versions"."delta") = 'object' and "record_versions"."delta" <> '{}'::jsonb
           and length(btrim(coalesce("record_versions"."reason", ''))) between 3 and 500))

skin_observations_note_check.name: skin_observations_note_check
skin_observations_note_check.value: "skin_observations"."note" is null or length(btrim("skin_observations"."note")) between 1 and 1000

document_template_versions_check.name: document_template_versions_check
document_template_versions_check.value:
"document_template_versions"."version" >= 1 and length("document_template_versions"."body") between 10 and 20000 and "document_template_versions"."paper" in ('a4','80mm','58mm')
      and ("document_template_versions"."kind" = 'receipt' or "document_template_versions"."paper" = 'a4') and "document_template_versions"."state" in ('active','retired') and "document_template_versions"."created_as" in ('owner','admin_pusat','facility_head')

document_templates_check.name: document_templates_check
document_templates_check.value:
"document_templates"."kind" in ('receipt','consent','letter','legal') and (("document_templates"."kind" = 'letter') = ("document_templates"."letter_type" is not null))
      and ("document_templates"."letter_type" is null or "document_templates"."letter_type" in ('surat_keterangan','rujukan','resume')) and length(btrim("document_templates"."name")) between 3 and 120
      and "document_templates"."created_as" in ('owner','admin_pusat','facility_head') and "document_templates"."state" in ('active','retired')
      and (("document_templates"."state" = 'retired') = (num_nonnulls("document_templates"."retired_at", "document_templates"."retired_by", "document_templates"."retired_as") = 3)) and num_nonnulls("document_templates"."retired_at", "document_templates"."retired_by", "document_templates"."retired_as") in (0, 3)

medical_letter_corrections_check.name: medical_letter_corrections_check
medical_letter_corrections_check.value:
"medical_letter_corrections"."state" in ('pending','approved','rejected','cancelled') and "medical_letter_corrections"."requested_as" = 'doctor'
      and length(btrim("medical_letter_corrections"."body")) between 10 and 40000 and length(btrim("medical_letter_corrections"."reason")) between 3 and 500
      and (("medical_letter_corrections"."state" = 'pending') = ("medical_letter_corrections"."decided_at" is null)) and (("medical_letter_corrections"."state" = 'approved') = ("medical_letter_corrections"."version_id" is not null))

medical_letter_versions_check.name: medical_letter_versions_check
medical_letter_versions_check.value:
"medical_letter_versions"."version" >= 1 and "medical_letter_versions"."kind" in ('original','correction')
      and (("medical_letter_versions"."kind" = 'original') = ("medical_letter_versions"."version" = 1)) and (("medical_letter_versions"."kind" = 'correction') = ("medical_letter_versions"."reason" is not null))
      and ("medical_letter_versions"."approval_id" is null or "medical_letter_versions"."kind" = 'correction') and ("medical_letter_versions"."reason" is null or length(btrim("medical_letter_versions"."reason")) between 3 and 500)
      and length(btrim("medical_letter_versions"."body")) between 10 and 40000 and "medical_letter_versions"."content_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and "medical_letter_versions"."created_as" = 'doctor'

medical_letters_check.name: medical_letters_check
medical_letters_check.value:
"medical_letters"."letter_type" in ('surat_keterangan','rujukan','resume') and "medical_letters"."state" in ('draft','signed')
      and length(btrim("medical_letters"."body")) between 10 and 40000
      and (("medical_letters"."state" = 'signed') = (num_nonnulls("medical_letters"."signed_at", "medical_letters"."signed_by", "medical_letters"."signed_as", "medical_letters"."content_hash") = 4))
      and num_nonnulls("medical_letters"."signed_at", "medical_letters"."signed_by", "medical_letters"."signed_as", "medical_letters"."content_hash") in (0, 4)
      and ("medical_letters"."signed_by" is null or ("medical_letters"."signed_by" = "medical_letters"."author_id" and "medical_letters"."signed_as" = 'doctor'))
      and ("medical_letters"."content_hash" is null or "medical_letters"."content_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

depot_transfers_check.name: depot_transfers_check
depot_transfers_check.value:
"depot_transfers"."kind" in ('intra','inter') and "depot_transfers"."state" in ('posted','sent','received','cancelled')
      and "depot_transfers"."command_key" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{8,128}$' and "depot_transfers"."created_as" in ('pharmacist','purchasing')
      and ("depot_transfers"."kind" = 'intra' and "depot_transfers"."from_branch_id" = "depot_transfers"."to_branch_id" and "depot_transfers"."state" = 'posted' and "depot_transfers"."to_depot_id" is not null and "depot_transfers"."to_depot_id" <> "depot_transfers"."from_depot_id"
           or "depot_transfers"."kind" = 'inter' and "depot_transfers"."from_branch_id" <> "depot_transfers"."to_branch_id" and "depot_transfers"."state" in ('sent','received','cancelled')
              and (("depot_transfers"."state" = 'received') = ("depot_transfers"."to_depot_id" is not null)))
      and (("depot_transfers"."state" in ('received','cancelled')) = ("depot_transfers"."closed_at" is not null)) and num_nonnulls("depot_transfers"."closed_by", "depot_transfers"."closed_as", "depot_transfers"."closed_at") in (0, 3)
      and ("depot_transfers"."closed_as" is null or "depot_transfers"."closed_as" in ('pharmacist','purchasing'))

depots_check.name: depots_check
depots_check.value:
"depots"."kind" in ('gudang','ruang','apotek') and length(btrim("depots"."name")) between 2 and 60
      and (not "depots"."is_default" or ("depots"."kind" = 'gudang' and "depots"."active")) and ("depots"."room_id" is null or "depots"."kind" = 'ruang')

material_consumption_lines_check.name: material_consumption_lines_check
material_consumption_lines_check.value:
"material_consumption_lines"."class_used" in ('bulk','standard','precise') and "material_consumption_lines"."quantity" between 0 and 1000000000 and scale("material_consumption_lines"."quantity") <= 4
      and "material_consumption_lines"."estimated" = ("material_consumption_lines"."class_used" = 'bulk') and (("material_consumption_lines"."batch_id" is null) = ("material_consumption_lines"."estimated" or "material_consumption_lines"."quantity" = 0))

material_request_lines_check.name: material_request_lines_check
material_request_lines_check.value: "material_request_lines"."material_class" in ('bulk','standard','precise') and "material_request_lines"."requested_qty" between 0.0001 and 1000000000 and scale("material_request_lines"."requested_qty") <= 4 and "material_request_lines"."requested_qty" > 0

material_requests_check.name: material_requests_check
material_requests_check.value:
"material_requests"."state" in ('open','issued','reconciled','cancelled') and "material_requests"."command_key" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{8,128}$'
      and "material_requests"."requested_as" in ('doctor','nurse','therapist','pharmacist') and (("material_requests"."state" in ('reconciled','cancelled')) = ("material_requests"."closed_at" is not null))

material_returns_check.name: material_returns_check
material_returns_check.value:
"material_returns"."condition" in ('unopened','opened','damaged') and "material_returns"."state" in ('pending','usable','waste') and "material_returns"."command_key" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{8,128}$'
      and "material_returns"."proposed_as" in ('doctor','nurse','therapist') and (("material_returns"."state" = 'usable') = ("material_returns"."to_depot_id" is not null))
      and ("material_returns"."state" <> 'usable' or "material_returns"."condition" <> 'damaged')
      and (("material_returns"."state" = 'pending') = ("material_returns"."decided_at" is null)) and num_nonnulls("material_returns"."decided_by", "material_returns"."decided_as", "material_returns"."decided_at") in (0, 3)
      and ("material_returns"."decided_as" is null or "material_returns"."decided_as" = 'pharmacist')

material_wastes_check.name: material_wastes_check
material_wastes_check.value: "material_wastes"."command_key" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{8,128}$' and "material_wastes"."wasted_as" in ('doctor','nurse','therapist') and length(btrim("material_wastes"."reason")) between 3 and 500

opened_vials_check.name: opened_vials_check
opened_vials_check.value:
"opened_vials"."remaining" between 0 and 100000 and scale("opened_vials"."remaining") <= 4 and "opened_vials"."use_by" > "opened_vials"."opened_at"
      and "opened_vials"."state" in ('open','finished','lapsed') and (("opened_vials"."state" = 'open') = ("opened_vials"."closed_at" is null))
      and "opened_vials"."opened_as" in ('pharmacist')

stock_batches_state_check.name: stock_batches_state_check
stock_batches_state_check.value:
"stock_batches"."state" in ('active','quarantined','temperature_excursion','recalled')
      and (("stock_batches"."state" = 'active') = ("stock_batches"."hold_reason" is null)) and num_nonnulls("stock_batches"."hold_reason", "stock_batches"."held_by", "stock_batches"."held_at") in (0, 3)
      and ("stock_batches"."hold_reason" is null or length(btrim("stock_batches"."hold_reason")) between 3 and 300)

stock_costs_check.name: stock_costs_check
stock_costs_check.value:
"stock_costs"."quantity" between 0 and 1000000000000 and scale("stock_costs"."quantity") <= 4 and "stock_costs"."uncosted_quantity" between 0 and 1000000000000 and scale("stock_costs"."uncosted_quantity") <= 4 and "stock_costs"."uncosted_quantity" <= "stock_costs"."quantity"
      and "stock_costs"."value" between 0 and 1000000000000000000 and ("stock_costs"."quantity" > "stock_costs"."uncosted_quantity" or "stock_costs"."value" = 0)
      and ("stock_costs"."last_unit_cost" is null or "stock_costs"."last_unit_cost" between 0 and 1000000000 and scale("stock_costs"."last_unit_cost") <= 4)

stock_count_lines_check.name: stock_count_lines_check
stock_count_lines_check.value:
"stock_count_lines"."system_qty" between 0 and 1000000000 and scale("stock_count_lines"."system_qty") <= 4 and ("stock_count_lines"."counted_qty" is null or "stock_count_lines"."counted_qty" between 0 and 1000000000 and scale("stock_count_lines"."counted_qty") <= 4)
      and (("stock_count_lines"."counted_qty" is null) = ("stock_count_lines"."counted_at" is null))

stock_counts_check.name: stock_counts_check
stock_counts_check.value:
"stock_counts"."state" in ('draft','pending_approval','applied','rejected','cancelled') and "stock_counts"."started_as" in ('pharmacist','manager')
      and ("stock_counts"."state" <> 'draft' or "stock_counts"."submitted_at" is null) and ("stock_counts"."state" not in ('pending_approval','applied','rejected') or "stock_counts"."submitted_at" is not null)
      and (("stock_counts"."state" in ('draft','pending_approval')) = ("stock_counts"."closed_at" is null))
      and (("stock_counts"."submitted_at" is null) = ("stock_counts"."reason" is null)) and ("stock_counts"."reason" is null or length(btrim("stock_counts"."reason")) between 3 and 500)
      and num_nonnulls("stock_counts"."threshold_pct", "stock_counts"."exceeds", "stock_counts"."submitted_at") in (0, 3)
      and ("stock_counts"."threshold_pct" is null or "stock_counts"."threshold_pct" between 0 and 100 and scale("stock_counts"."threshold_pct") <= 4)
      and (("stock_counts"."approval_id" is not null) = coalesce("stock_counts"."exceeds", false))
      and ("stock_counts"."state" <> 'pending_approval' or "stock_counts"."approval_id" is not null)
      and ("stock_counts"."state" <> 'rejected' or "stock_counts"."approval_id" is not null)

stock_items_vial_check.name: stock_items_vial_check
stock_items_vial_check.value:
(("stock_items"."vial_size" is null) = ("stock_items"."opened_use_hours" is null))
      and ("stock_items"."vial_size" is null or "stock_items"."vial_size" between 0.0001 and 100000 and scale("stock_items"."vial_size") <= 4 and "stock_items"."vial_size" > 0)
      and ("stock_items"."opened_use_hours" is null or "stock_items"."opened_use_hours" between 1 and 8760)

stock_levels_check.name: stock_levels_check
stock_levels_check.value:
"stock_levels"."min_qty" between 0 and 1000000000 and scale("stock_levels"."min_qty") <= 4 and "stock_levels"."target_qty" between 0 and 1000000000 and scale("stock_levels"."target_qty") <= 4 and "stock_levels"."target_qty" >= "stock_levels"."min_qty"
      and "stock_levels"."updated_as" in ('pharmacist','purchasing')

stock_movement_values_check.name: stock_movement_values_check
stock_movement_values_check.value:
"stock_movement_values"."quantity" between -1000000000 and 1000000000 and scale("stock_movement_values"."quantity") <= 4 and "stock_movement_values"."quantity" <> 0
      and "stock_movement_values"."uncosted_qty" between -1000000000 and 1000000000 and scale("stock_movement_values"."uncosted_qty") <= 4 and abs("stock_movement_values"."uncosted_qty") <= abs("stock_movement_values"."quantity") and sign("stock_movement_values"."uncosted_qty") in (0, sign("stock_movement_values"."quantity"))
      and "stock_movement_values"."value" between -1000000000000000000 and 1000000000000000000 and sign("stock_movement_values"."value") in (0, sign("stock_movement_values"."quantity"))
      and ("stock_movement_values"."unit_cost" is null or "stock_movement_values"."unit_cost" between 0 and 1000000000 and scale("stock_movement_values"."unit_cost") <= 4)
      and "stock_movement_values"."quantity_after" between 0 and 1000000000000 and scale("stock_movement_values"."quantity_after") <= 4 and "stock_movement_values"."uncosted_after" between 0 and 1000000000000 and scale("stock_movement_values"."uncosted_after") <= 4 and "stock_movement_values"."uncosted_after" <= "stock_movement_values"."quantity_after"
      and "stock_movement_values"."value_after" between 0 and 1000000000000000000 and ("stock_movement_values"."quantity_after" > "stock_movement_values"."uncosted_after" or "stock_movement_values"."value_after" = 0)

stock_movements_check.name: stock_movements_check
stock_movements_check.value:
"stock_movements"."kind" in ('receive','adjust','issue','consume','return','waste','transfer_out','transfer_in','supplier_return','dispense') and "stock_movements"."quantity" between -1000000000 and 1000000000 and scale("stock_movements"."quantity") <= 4 and "stock_movements"."quantity" <> 0
      and "stock_movements"."balance_after" between 0 and 1000000000 and scale("stock_movements"."balance_after") <= 4 and "stock_movements"."source_kind" ~ '^[a-z][a-z_]{1,40}$'
      and ("stock_movements"."reason" is null or length(btrim("stock_movements"."reason")) between 3 and 500)
      and "stock_movements"."depot_balance_after" between 0 and 1000000000 and scale("stock_movements"."depot_balance_after") <= 4
      and ("stock_movements"."kind" = 'receive' and "stock_movements"."leg" is null and "stock_movements"."quantity" > 0
           or "stock_movements"."kind" = 'adjust' and "stock_movements"."leg" is null
           or "stock_movements"."kind" in ('consume','waste','supplier_return','dispense') and "stock_movements"."leg" is null and "stock_movements"."quantity" < 0
           or "stock_movements"."kind" = 'transfer_out' and "stock_movements"."leg" is not distinct from 'out' and "stock_movements"."quantity" < 0
           or "stock_movements"."kind" = 'transfer_in' and "stock_movements"."leg" is not distinct from 'in' and "stock_movements"."quantity" > 0
           or "stock_movements"."kind" in ('issue','return') and ("stock_movements"."leg" is not distinct from 'out' and "stock_movements"."quantity" < 0
                                                  or "stock_movements"."leg" is not distinct from 'in' and "stock_movements"."quantity" > 0)
           -- T-078 (DATA-61, scenario 15 J2): a product a patient returns on a refund comes back with no leg.
           or "stock_movements"."kind" = 'return' and "stock_movements"."leg" is null and "stock_movements"."quantity" > 0 and "stock_movements"."source_kind" = 'refund')

treatment_execution_events_check.name: treatment_execution_events_check
treatment_execution_events_check.value:
"treatment_execution_events"."kind" in ('start','stage','pause','resume','finish') and "treatment_execution_events"."command_key" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{8,128}$' and "treatment_execution_events"."as" in ('doctor','nurse','therapist')
      and (("treatment_execution_events"."kind" = 'stage') = ("treatment_execution_events"."stage" is not null)) and (("treatment_execution_events"."kind" = 'finish') = ("treatment_execution_events"."outcome" is not null))
      and ("treatment_execution_events"."stage" is null or "treatment_execution_events"."stage" in ('preparation','anesthesia','procedure','recovery')) and ("treatment_execution_events"."outcome" is null or "treatment_execution_events"."outcome" in ('completed','medical_stop','clinic_stop','patient_stop'))

treatment_executions_check.name: treatment_executions_check
treatment_executions_check.value:
"treatment_executions"."state" in ('started','paused','finished') and "treatment_executions"."stage" in ('preparation','anesthesia','procedure','recovery')
      and "treatment_executions"."started_as" in ('doctor','nurse','therapist') and "treatment_executions"."identity_confirmed" and "treatment_executions"."start_command_key" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{8,128}$'
      and ("treatment_executions"."assisting_staff_id" is null or "treatment_executions"."assisting_staff_id" <> "treatment_executions"."performer_staff_id")
      and ("treatment_executions"."supervisor_staff_id" is null or "treatment_executions"."supervisor_staff_id" <> "treatment_executions"."performer_staff_id")
      and (("treatment_executions"."state" = 'paused') = ("treatment_executions"."paused_at" is not null))
      and (("treatment_executions"."state" = 'finished') = ("treatment_executions"."finished_at" is not null)) and num_nonnulls("treatment_executions"."finished_at", "treatment_executions"."finished_by", "treatment_executions"."finished_as", "treatment_executions"."finish_command_key", "treatment_executions"."outcome") in (0, 5)
      and ("treatment_executions"."finished_as" is null or "treatment_executions"."finished_as" in ('doctor','nurse','therapist')) and ("treatment_executions"."finish_command_key" is null or "treatment_executions"."finish_command_key" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{8,128}$')
      and ("treatment_executions"."outcome" is null or "treatment_executions"."outcome" in ('completed','medical_stop','clinic_stop','patient_stop'))
      and (("treatment_executions"."outcome" in ('medical_stop','clinic_stop','patient_stop')) = ("treatment_executions"."stop_reason" is not null))
      and ("treatment_executions"."stop_reason" is null or length(btrim("treatment_executions"."stop_reason")) between 3 and 500)

dispensings_check.name: dispensings_check
dispensings_check.value:
"dispensings"."state" in ('queued','prepared','handed','cancelled') and "dispensings"."quantity" between 0.0001 and 1000000000 and scale("dispensings"."quantity") <= 4
      and num_nonnulls("dispensings"."selection_item_id", "dispensings"."prescription_item_id", "dispensings"."invoice_line_id") = 1
      and (("dispensings"."invoice_line_id" is null) = ("dispensings"."visit_id" is not null)) and ("dispensings"."visit_id" is null or "dispensings"."patient_id" is not null)
      and num_nonnulls("dispensings"."prepared_at", "dispensings"."prepared_by", "dispensings"."prepare_key", "dispensings"."depot_id") in (0, 4)
      and num_nonnulls("dispensings"."handed_at", "dispensings"."handed_by", "dispensings"."hand_key", "dispensings"."checks") in (0, 4)
      and num_nonnulls("dispensings"."cancelled_at", "dispensings"."cancelled_by", "dispensings"."cancel_reason") in (0, 3)
      and (("dispensings"."state" in ('prepared','handed')) <= ("dispensings"."prepared_at" is not null))
      and (("dispensings"."state" = 'handed') = ("dispensings"."handed_at" is not null)) and (("dispensings"."state" = 'cancelled') = ("dispensings"."cancelled_at" is not null))
      and ("dispensings"."prepare_key" is null or "dispensings"."prepare_key" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{8,128}$') and ("dispensings"."hand_key" is null or "dispensings"."hand_key" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{8,128}$')
      and ("dispensings"."checks" is null or jsonb_typeof("dispensings"."checks") = 'object')
      and ("dispensings"."exception_note" is null or length(btrim("dispensings"."exception_note")) between 3 and 500) and ("dispensings"."exception_note" is null or "dispensings"."handed_at" is not null)
      and ("dispensings"."cancel_reason" is null or length(btrim("dispensings"."cancel_reason")) between 3 and 300)

pharmacy_recipe_items_check.name: pharmacy_recipe_items_check
pharmacy_recipe_items_check.value: "pharmacy_recipe_items"."row_index" between 0 and 49 and "pharmacy_recipe_items"."quantity" between 0.0001 and 1000000000 and scale("pharmacy_recipe_items"."quantity") <= 4

prescription_items_check.name: prescription_items_check
prescription_items_check.value:
"prescription_items"."quantity" between 0.0001 and 1000000000 and scale("prescription_items"."quantity") <= 4 and length(btrim("prescription_items"."signa")) between 3 and 200
      and ("prescription_items"."kfa_code" is null or "prescription_items"."kfa_code" ~ '^[0-9A-Za-z.-]{3,40}$')

prescriptions_check.name: prescriptions_check
prescriptions_check.value:
"prescriptions"."state" in ('draft','signed') and "prescriptions"."command_key" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{8,128}$'
      and (("prescriptions"."state" = 'signed') = ("prescriptions"."signed_at" is not null)) and num_nonnulls("prescriptions"."signed_at", "prescriptions"."valid_until", "prescriptions"."set48_snapshot") in (0, 3)
      and ("prescriptions"."valid_until" is null or "prescriptions"."valid_until" > "prescriptions"."signed_at")

selection_items_check.name: selection_items_check
selection_items_check.value:
"selection_items"."kind" in ('service','product') and "selection_items"."quantity" between 0.0001 and 1000000000 and scale("selection_items"."quantity") <= 4
      and ("selection_items"."material_request_id" is null or "selection_items"."kind" = 'service')

selections_check.name: selections_check
selections_check.value:
"selections"."command_key" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{8,128}$' and "selections"."confirmed_as" in ('bc','doctor','fo_cashier')
      and ("selections"."signature_ref" is null or length("selections"."signature_ref") between 8 and 200)

stock_batch_holds_check.name: stock_batch_holds_check
stock_batch_holds_check.value:
"stock_batch_holds"."from_state" in ('active','quarantined','temperature_excursion','recalled') and "stock_batch_holds"."to_state" in ('active','quarantined','temperature_excursion','recalled')
      and "stock_batch_holds"."from_state" <> "stock_batch_holds"."to_state" and "stock_batch_holds"."as" = 'pharmacist' and length(btrim("stock_batch_holds"."reason")) between 3 and 300

goods_receipts_check.name: goods_receipts_check
goods_receipts_check.value: "goods_receipts"."command_key" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{8,128}$' and "goods_receipts"."received_as" in ('pharmacist','purchasing') and ("goods_receipts"."delivery_note" is null or "goods_receipts"."delivery_note" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9./ -]{0,39}$')

purchase_order_lines_check.name: purchase_order_lines_check
purchase_order_lines_check.value:
"purchase_order_lines"."ordered_qty" between 0.0001 and 1000000000 and scale("purchase_order_lines"."ordered_qty") <= 4 and "purchase_order_lines"."received_qty" between 0 and "purchase_order_lines"."ordered_qty" and scale("purchase_order_lines"."received_qty") <= 4
      and "purchase_order_lines"."unit_price" between 0 and 1000000000 and ("purchase_order_lines"."active" or "purchase_order_lines"."received_qty" = 0)

purchase_orders_check.name: purchase_orders_check
purchase_orders_check.value:
"purchase_orders"."state" in ('draft','sent','partially_received','received','cancelled') and "purchase_orders"."number" ~ '^PO-[0-9]{6}-[0-9]{4,6}$' and "purchase_orders"."command_key" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{8,128}$'
      and ("purchase_orders"."expected_date" is null or "purchase_orders"."expected_date" ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$') and ("purchase_orders"."note" is null or length(btrim("purchase_orders"."note")) between 1 and 300)
      and (("purchase_orders"."state" = 'draft') = ("purchase_orders"."sent_at" is null) or "purchase_orders"."state" = 'cancelled')
      and (("purchase_orders"."state" = 'cancelled') = ("purchase_orders"."cancelled_at" is not null)) and (("purchase_orders"."cancelled_at" is null) = ("purchase_orders"."cancel_reason" is null)) and ("purchase_orders"."cancel_reason" is null or length(btrim("purchase_orders"."cancel_reason")) between 3 and 300)

supplier_credit_expectations_check.name: supplier_credit_expectations_check
supplier_credit_expectations_check.value:
"supplier_credit_expectations"."amount" between 0 and 1000000000000000000 and "supplier_credit_expectations"."state" in ('expected','received','written_off')
      and (("supplier_credit_expectations"."state" = 'expected') = ("supplier_credit_expectations"."closed_at" is null)) and num_nonnulls("supplier_credit_expectations"."closed_by", "supplier_credit_expectations"."closed_as", "supplier_credit_expectations"."closed_at") in (0, 3)
      and (("supplier_credit_expectations"."state" = 'received') = ("supplier_credit_expectations"."credit_note_id" is not null))
      and (("supplier_credit_expectations"."state" = 'written_off') = ("supplier_credit_expectations"."closed_reason" is not null))
      and ("supplier_credit_expectations"."closed_reason" is null or length(btrim("supplier_credit_expectations"."closed_reason")) between 3 and 300)
      and ("supplier_credit_expectations"."closed_as" is null or "supplier_credit_expectations"."closed_as" in ('finance','purchasing','owner','admin_pusat'))

supplier_credit_notes_check.name: supplier_credit_notes_check
supplier_credit_notes_check.value:
"supplier_credit_notes"."number" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9./ -]{0,39}$' and "supplier_credit_notes"."amount" between 1 and 1000000000000000000 and "supplier_credit_notes"."tax_amount" between 0 and "supplier_credit_notes"."amount"
      and "supplier_credit_notes"."available_amount" between 0 and "supplier_credit_notes"."amount" and "supplier_credit_notes"."source_kind" in ('return','invoice')
      and (("supplier_credit_notes"."source_kind" = 'return') = ("supplier_credit_notes"."return_id" is not null)) and (("supplier_credit_notes"."source_kind" = 'invoice') = ("supplier_credit_notes"."invoice_id" is not null))
      and "supplier_credit_notes"."issued_on" ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' and "supplier_credit_notes"."state" in ('live','reversed') and "supplier_credit_notes"."command_key" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{8,128}$' and "supplier_credit_notes"."recorded_as" in ('purchasing','finance')
      and ("supplier_credit_notes"."state" <> 'reversed' or "supplier_credit_notes"."available_amount" = 0)
      and (("supplier_credit_notes"."state" = 'reversed') = ("supplier_credit_notes"."reversed_at" is not null)) and num_nonnulls("supplier_credit_notes"."reversed_at", "supplier_credit_notes"."reversed_by", "supplier_credit_notes"."reverse_reason") in (0, 3) and ("supplier_credit_notes"."reverse_reason" is null or length(btrim("supplier_credit_notes"."reverse_reason")) between 3 and 300)

supplier_invoice_lines_receipt_open_key.name: supplier_invoice_lines_receipt_open_key
supplier_invoice_lines_receipt_open_key.where: receipt_id is not null and not reversed

supplier_invoices_check.name: supplier_invoices_check
supplier_invoices_check.value:
"supplier_invoices"."kind" in ('purchase','expense') and (("supplier_invoices"."kind" = 'expense') = ("supplier_invoices"."expense_id" is not null))
      and "supplier_invoices"."number" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9./ -]{0,39}$' and "supplier_invoices"."invoice_date" ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' and "supplier_invoices"."due_date" ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' and "supplier_invoices"."due_date" >= "supplier_invoices"."invoice_date"
      and "supplier_invoices"."total" between 1 and 1000000000000000000 and "supplier_invoices"."paid_amount" between 0 and 1000000000000000000 and "supplier_invoices"."credited_amount" between 0 and 1000000000000000000 and "supplier_invoices"."paid_amount" + "supplier_invoices"."credited_amount" <= "supplier_invoices"."total"
      and "supplier_invoices"."state" in ('open','paid','reversed') and "supplier_invoices"."command_key" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{8,128}$' and "supplier_invoices"."recorded_as" in ('purchasing','finance')
      and (("supplier_invoices"."state" = 'paid') = ("supplier_invoices"."paid_amount" + "supplier_invoices"."credited_amount" = "supplier_invoices"."total" and "supplier_invoices"."state" <> 'reversed'))
      and ("supplier_invoices"."state" <> 'reversed' or ("supplier_invoices"."paid_amount" = 0 and "supplier_invoices"."credited_amount" = 0))
      and (("supplier_invoices"."state" = 'reversed') = ("supplier_invoices"."reversed_at" is not null)) and num_nonnulls("supplier_invoices"."reversed_at", "supplier_invoices"."reversed_by", "supplier_invoices"."reverse_reason") in (0, 3) and ("supplier_invoices"."reverse_reason" is null or length(btrim("supplier_invoices"."reverse_reason")) between 3 and 300)

supplier_payments_check.name: supplier_payments_check
supplier_payments_check.value:
"supplier_payments"."amount" between 1 and 1000000000000000000 and "supplier_payments"."allocated_amount" between 0 and "supplier_payments"."amount" and "supplier_payments"."method" in ('cash','bank_transfer')
      and "supplier_payments"."paid_on" ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' and ("supplier_payments"."reference" is null or "supplier_payments"."reference" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9./ -]{0,39}$') and "supplier_payments"."state" in ('live','reversed')
      and "supplier_payments"."command_key" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{8,128}$' and ("supplier_payments"."state" <> 'reversed' or "supplier_payments"."allocated_amount" = 0)
      and (("supplier_payments"."state" = 'reversed') = ("supplier_payments"."reversed_at" is not null)) and num_nonnulls("supplier_payments"."reversed_at", "supplier_payments"."reversed_by", "supplier_payments"."reverse_reason") in (0, 3) and ("supplier_payments"."reverse_reason" is null or length(btrim("supplier_payments"."reverse_reason")) between 3 and 300)

supplier_receipts_check.name: supplier_receipts_check
supplier_receipts_check.value:
"supplier_receipts"."quantity" between 0.0001 and 1000000000 and scale("supplier_receipts"."quantity") <= 4 and "supplier_receipts"."unit_cost" between 0 and 1000000000
      and "supplier_receipts"."source_kind" in ('supplier_receipt','goods_receipt') and (("supplier_receipts"."source_kind" = 'supplier_receipt') = ("supplier_receipts"."command_key" is not null))
      and ("supplier_receipts"."command_key" is null or "supplier_receipts"."command_key" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{8,128}$') and "supplier_receipts"."received_as" in ('pharmacist','purchasing')
      and ("supplier_receipts"."delivery_note" is null or "supplier_receipts"."delivery_note" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9./ -]{0,39}$')

supplier_returns_check.name: supplier_returns_check
supplier_returns_check.value:
"supplier_returns"."quantity" between 0.0001 and 1000000000 and scale("supplier_returns"."quantity") <= 4 and "supplier_returns"."reason" in ('expired','near_expiry','damaged','recalled','wrong_item','quality','other')
      and length(btrim("supplier_returns"."note")) between 3 and 300 and "supplier_returns"."command_key" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{8,128}$'
      and "supplier_returns"."value" between 0 and 1000000000000000000 and "supplier_returns"."uncosted_qty" between 0 and "supplier_returns"."quantity" and scale("supplier_returns"."uncosted_qty") <= 4
      and "supplier_returns"."returned_as" in ('purchasing','pharmacist','manager','admin_pusat','owner')
      and ("supplier_returns"."credit_note_ref" is null or "supplier_returns"."credit_note_ref" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9./ -]{0,39}$')

suppliers_check.name: suppliers_check
suppliers_check.value:
length(btrim("suppliers"."name")) between 2 and 120 and "suppliers"."payment_terms_days" between 0 and 180
      and ("suppliers"."npwp" is null or "suppliers"."npwp" ~ '^[0-9]{15,16}$')
      and ("suppliers"."contact_name" is null or length(btrim("suppliers"."contact_name")) between 2 and 120)
      and ("suppliers"."phone" is null or "suppliers"."phone" ~ '^\+?[0-9 -]{6,20}$')
      and ("suppliers"."email" is null or ("suppliers"."email" ~ '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$' and length("suppliers"."email") <= 200))
      and ("suppliers"."address" is null or length(btrim("suppliers"."address")) between 3 and 300)

clinical_incidents_check.name: clinical_incidents_check
clinical_incidents_check.value:
"clinical_incidents"."classification" in ('ktd','knc','ktc','kpc','sentinel') and "clinical_incidents"."state" in ('reported','investigating','closed') and "clinical_incidents"."command_key" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{8,128}$'
      and ("clinical_incidents"."classification" <> 'kpc' or "clinical_incidents"."patient_id" is null) and ("clinical_incidents"."visit_id" is null or "clinical_incidents"."patient_id" is not null)
      and ("clinical_incidents"."state" = 'reported') = ("clinical_incidents"."officer_id" is null)
      and ("clinical_incidents"."investigated_at" is null) = ("clinical_incidents"."investigation" is null) and ("clinical_incidents"."investigation" is null) = ("clinical_incidents"."root_cause" is null)
      and ("clinical_incidents"."report_required" is not false or "clinical_incidents"."report_recipient" is null and "clinical_incidents"."report_due_on" is null)
      and ("clinical_incidents"."report_required" is not true or "clinical_incidents"."report_recipient" is not null and "clinical_incidents"."report_due_on" is not null)
      and ("clinical_incidents"."submitted_at" is null) = ("clinical_incidents"."submission_ref" is null) and ("clinical_incidents"."submitted_at" is null or "clinical_incidents"."report_required" is true)
      and ("clinical_incidents"."state" = 'closed') = ("clinical_incidents"."closed_at" is not null) and ("clinical_incidents"."closed_at" is null) = ("clinical_incidents"."closed_by" is null)
      and ("clinical_incidents"."state" <> 'closed' or "clinical_incidents"."investigated_at" is not null and "clinical_incidents"."corrective_action" is not null and "clinical_incidents"."report_required" is not null
           and ("clinical_incidents"."report_required" is false or "clinical_incidents"."submitted_at" is not null))

clinical_incidents_text_check.name: clinical_incidents_text_check
clinical_incidents_text_check.value:
length(btrim("clinical_incidents"."summary")) between 3 and 1000 and length(btrim("clinical_incidents"."immediate_response")) between 3 and 1000
